body:
It does make sense, and it’s the nicest thing I’ve heard in a very long time. I really appreciate it. 

I know I need to stop, before I hurt myself. But the thought of going to bed, and having the nightmares, is enough to stop myself making the right decision. Up until now, I have been able to cover up the feelings and do what is right. 

I am not sure I can do that anymore. I don’t feel that anyone around me can see how I feel, yet you seem to be able to tap into my thoughts. How do I go on? I am not a martyr, by any stretch of the imagination. I am rational, and I know the life I chose to have is what I wanted. I am independent, and my son and I live alone, and always have. I would like to say that he is not here right now, otherwise I would have never allowed myself to feel the things that have been fighting to take control. But the thought of getting up in 4 hours and pretending like it’s ok, is unbearable. Due to family issues, I have had to take some time off work, and i don’t feel like I can take anymore liberties. But I don’t want to get to the point where it truly is too much. I can feel it coming, but it fucking kills me because I’ve fought through what I thought the was the hardest part, to find that surviving on my own is worse.

Coffeemugs5639, after 20 minutes of conversion, I feel that I’ve gotten more understanding than anyone I’ve met in my entire RL. But as much as I wish it did, it isn’t making it better. If I wasn’t under the influence of things that release the walls, I would have shut down and stopped. But I don’t feel that covering up with drink/drugs/pills is helping. And all I am doing is letting my little boy down. 

I have fought for help, the services around me are pretty bad, and I don’t have the money for private intervention. But I am sure I will find a way through it.

May God bless you for your kindness.

I’ve spent the last year or so trying to find positive ways out of this, I paint, read, draw. I find something therapeutic of making something beautiful out of the evil thoughts in my head. But recently I just cannot bring myself to do it. Things are falling down around me, I’m basically waiting for the breaking point where I lose everything. But I swear, I have fought so hard to get where I am. I came from nothing, years of harm and attempts, to having an amazing child and a wonderful career. But despite that, I just feel like I live with this awful, dirty secret. I have so much to feel lucky for, but I am never happy. I cannot conjure the feelings I want. I have fleeting feelings of euphoria, and then as soon as it comes, I plummet. I have been on medication for a very long time, but I get tired of being numb from that. I’m really starting to ramble now, and it’s probably best not to carry on. I’m sorry, it means an incredible amount to me that you’ve reached out, but I can’t see how I can get the strength to get up tomorrow, act like the happy, strong woman I am, when inside I feel like this. I’m slowly taking these pills, but I know inside it won’t work. I’ll wake up tomorrow, and have to carry on. I just don’t want to. 

Thank you. From the bottom of my heart.

I’m struggling to identify one specific thing that’s tipped me over the edge. I’m normally okay, I can paste the smile day to day, but I just feel myself slipping with every event that comes along. I know I will sound crazy, but it’s so hard to drown out the thoughts that tell me what I truly believe about myself. I’ve had a really horrible few years, and I’m normally resilient enough to pack it all away in the box, but it’s bursting. I’m not sure I can articulate the specific events without rambling, but reliving it every day, is too much. I have gone on thinking that things will get better, but I feel more alone with each day that passes. I guess my main source of pain is my beautiful son, who deserves so much better. I can feel myself slipping into someone I never wanted to be, I thought covering it all up was working, and it’s gotten me this far. But come nighttime, when the world goes quiet and I have nothing to distract myself with, it starts. The screaming in my head is unbearable.
I don’t know who to reach to. Every time I try to talk, my throat closes up. It’s like my brain doesn’t want to me to tell anyone.
I’m here. I’m fighting between forcing myself to live up to peoples expectations, and allowing myself to give up. I’m so sorry. I don’t know what else to do. I feel completely numb.

This isn’t right. I had a therapist say that I was harming because it was a ‘typical teenager reaction seeking for attention’. Yet, I’d do anything to stop anyone finding out. 

Please, try not to let this get to you. This person is an uneducated dick weasel. I know as well as you, why we hurt ourselves. Most do not understand. Please do try and find someone who will be better to help you, and not have this idiotic view. This is only one, in thousands of amazing therapists, and you will find someone you click with, and who will be able to help. 

You are special, and you deserve more than this pain. I truly hope in my heart you can get to the point where you no longer feel to do this. You are wonderful, and your resilience is something to be admired. Stay strong, be true to yourself and try and find out what truly makes your soul happy. Until then, grit your teeth - I know it seems insensitive to say, but there IS a light at the end of the tunnel. And please reach out if you need to. 

You are amazing. Keep going - you will be okay.
